title: ClaimSubmission
description: Repository-agnostic shape of a refund/complaint claim, as defined by src/repositories/JotFormRepository.ts's ClaimSubmission type. Both JotFormRepository.submit() and OdooRepository.submit() (Phase B, not yet implemented) accept exactly this shape — syncClaim.ts builds it once from a Claims doc and dispatches to whichever repository doc.integrationTarget selects, so Odoo's implementation must consume the same fields to be a drop-in swap. JotForm-specific concerns (the qid mapping, compound-field splitting, option-label translation) live only inside JotFormRepository.ts and are NOT part of this contract — Odoo gets plain, already-clean values.

kioskBrand.description: Resolved brand display name (e.g. "Carlo's Bakery"), not the internal Brands collection relationship ID. Resolved from the relationship before building the submission — see syncClaim.ts.

paymentMethod.description: Internal slug matching Claims.paymentMethod's select options. JotFormRepository maps this to JotForm's exact option text (e.g. 'card' -> 'Credit/Debit Card') internally — Odoo should decide its own mapping independently, this field stays the slug.

customerName.description: Full name as a single string (Claims.customerName is one text field). JotFormRepository splits it into first/last internally for JotForm's compound Name field — that split is JotForm-specific, not part of this contract.

customerPhone.description: As entered by the customer, no fixed format enforced today.

transactionDateTime.description: ISO 8601 timestamp. JotFormRepository splits this into month/day/year/hour/min/ampm internally for JotForm's compound date/time field — that split is JotForm-specific.

location.description: Structured location, matching Claims.location's group field. JotFormRepository concatenates these into one string for JotForm's single free-text location question — Odoo can likely keep them structured if its API supports that.

claimReason.description: Internal slug matching Claims.claimReason's select options. JotFormRepository maps this to JotForm's exact option text (including JotForm's trailing periods) internally.

additionalInfo.description: Optional free-text detail from the customer.

lastFourCardDigits.description: Optional, only meaningful when paymentMethod is 'card'.

refundMethod.description: Optional — only relevant for cash refunds (card refunds return to the card automatically). Values already match JotForm's option text verbatim, unlike paymentMethod/claimReason, since this select was added specifically to mirror JotForm qid 20.

refundAccount.description: Optional — username/email/phone for the refundMethod account above.

photo.description: Optional. NOT persisted in the Claims collection or in Payload Media — captured only in-memory during the public submission request and passed through req.context to the afterChange hook (see syncClaim.ts and next/claims-submit/route.ts), so it only exists for the duration of that one request. Odoo's implementation, if it needs the file, must accept and forward it the same way — there is no stored URL to fetch it from afterward.

contentType.description: Allowlisted by magic-byte sniffing server-side in next/claims-submit/route.ts, not trusted from the client-supplied MIME type.
